title: Computational insight of antioxidant and doxorubicin combination for effective cancer therapy.
authors: Nayak, Jyotsnamayee; P, Seshu Vardhan; Sahoo, Suban K; Kumar, Manish; Vashistha, Vinod Kumar; Kumar, Rajender
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接和MD模拟研究抗氧化剂与阿霉素对拓扑异构酶II和亲环蛋白D的结合，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作，但对象为小分子药物与蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Doxorubicin (DOX) is the most effective antineoplastic agent, destroys cancer cells by interrupting cellular function. However, the serious side effects on the heart limits its utility. To curb these unwanted side effects, nutritionist recommend antioxidants use along with DOX while chemotherapy. But it was not supported by various oncologists as it can alter the toxicity of DOX towards cancer cells. Therefore, here we explored the in silico pharmacokinetics and combination effect of DOX and antioxidants on topoisomerases-II (Top-II) and cyclophilin D (Cyp-D) therapeutic targets involved in cancer proliferation and post-myocardial infarction, respectively. The molecular docking study was conducted on target proteins and DOX including most prescribed antioxidants (melatonin, N-acetylcysteine (NAC), glutathione (GSH), beta-carotene and vitamin C). GSH showed effective binding potential for Top-II and Cyp-D active sites, but other considered antioxidants possess low binding affinity. The highest docked conformations were subjected to molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to understand conformer stability of DOX and GSH with Cyp-D and Top-II for 100 ns. The results revealed that ligands pose at Top-II active sites where DOX showed strong binding affinity to DNA binding pocket and GSH to a buried site. The computational data summarised and proposed the GSH and DOX combination as antagonist effects on Top-II. Conversely, the binding compactness of GSH improved due to surface fit at the active pocket of Cyp-D and completely blocking DOX binding affinity, suppress adverse reactions of post-myocardial infarction.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 阿霉素（DOX）是最有效的抗肿瘤药物，通过干扰细胞功能来破坏癌细胞。然而，其对心脏的严重副作用限制了其应用。为遏制这些不良副作用，营养学家建议在化疗期间将抗氧化剂与DOX联合使用。但这一建议并未得到多位肿瘤学家的支持，因为抗氧化剂可能改变DOX对癌细胞的毒性。因此，本研究探讨了DOX与抗氧化剂对拓扑异构酶-II（Top-II）和亲环蛋白D（Cyp-D）治疗靶点的计算机模拟药代动力学及联合效应，这两个靶点分别涉及癌症增殖和心肌梗死后状态。分子对接研究针对靶蛋白和DOX以及最常处方的抗氧化剂（褪黑素、N-乙酰半胱氨酸（NAC）、谷胱甘肽（GSH）、β-胡萝卜素和维生素C）进行。GSH对Top-II和Cyp-D活性位点表现出有效的结合潜力，而其他所考虑的抗氧化剂则具有较低的结合亲和力。最高对接构象进行了分子动力学（MD）模拟，以了解DOX和GSH与Cyp-D和Top-II在100 ns内的构象稳定性。结果表明，配体位于Top-II活性位点，其中DOX对DNA结合口袋表现出强结合亲和力，而GSH则结合于一个埋藏位点。计算数据总结并提出GSH与DOX联合对Top-II具有拮抗效应。相反，由于GSH在Cyp-D活性口袋处的表面匹配，其结合紧密性得到改善，并完全阻断DOX的结合亲和力，从而抑制心肌梗死后不良反应。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
